method: Ordinary visible controls with screenshot-driven pause-assisted agent play. Screenshots inspected before decisions. No source, tests, assets, documents, prior reports, hidden state, or test URL inspected. Only driver --help and visible How To were read.
raw_actions_and_outcomes: Preserved by visible driver in output directory and session transcript; sequences 1–35, then explicit close.

observations: Advanced past induction guard without eliminating it; initial firing missed.
Recovered East then Heart using visible markers and hold E prompts.
Opened M facility map after discovering it in handbook and HUD; map showed receiver reach, cover and extraction, and visibly paused mission.
At West, 3.8m MOVE CLOSER prompt persisted while strafing across receiver face; failed to enter reach before incoming fire killed operator.
Adjusted aim against visible induction optic and earned critical elimination.
Used sprint and ordinary receiver prompts to recover West, Heart, East.
Killed second warden by aiming at visible optic.
Overshot East initially, corrected direction from screenshot/minimap, recovered all memories.
Reached extraction using green marker, remained stationary within floor ring while uplink rose from 22% to completion.
Rain, wet reflections, cyan/orange lighting and restrained menu typography establish a coherent industrial storm mood.
Main objective, ammo, health and hold-E prompts are readable; receiver cards provide named human stakes.
Facility map was naturally discoverable via How To and HUD M label. Its explicit wall/cover/receiver legend helped route planning.
Receiver markers through cover gave useful direction but did not guarantee a direct approach; small reach boundary required careful adjustment under attack.
Combat optic targeting had a visible payoff in second attempt. Enemy bodies and environment remain simple and angular, with repeated concrete facades and cover.
Orange charge/recent-fire indicators communicated pressure but several simultaneous broad chevrons did not tell me exactly where every attacker was.
Mission completion was possible with two kills, so movement and objective interaction dominated this playthrough.
Visible menu says BUILD 37 despite review artifact name build38; observed label only, no source-version inference.

rating_rationale.gameplay: Working short objective loop with meaningful optic precision, movement and hold-zone tension; limited encounter variety in observed mission.
rating_rationale.presentation: Strong coherent atmosphere and UI composition; simple models and repeated geometry limit finish.
rating_rationale.usability: Controls explained and objectives clear; receiver reach and cover required retries.
rating_rationale.readability: Core HUD and ring feedback clear, but small fine text and concurrent directional cues are harder to parse.
rating_rationale.AAA_readiness: Credible playable prototype slice; observed visual detail, variety and refinement fall well short of an AAA release.

uncertainties: Pause assistance and coarse timed actions substantially affect difficulty and aiming; these are not human enjoyment findings.
Audio was not assessed. Software-WebGL fallback was enabled; no hardware performance certification.
Did not test upload decay outside ring, map persistence across multiple actions, settings, every combat maneuver, or alternate routes.
No page errors appeared in driver results; this does not establish general defect absence.

closure.pid_verification: ps -p 74912,74913 -o pid=,comm= returned no rows and exit 1, confirming exact PIDs absent.
